mapper.select: SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer_name, o.title, o.status, o.created_at FROM inquiry o JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.parent_id IS NULL AND o.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiry o WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.parent_id IS NULL AND o.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer_name, o.title, o.status, o.created_at FROM inquiry o JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer_name, o.title, o.content, o.status, o.created_at, r.content AS reply_content, re.name AS reply_author_name, r.created_at AS replied_at FROM inquiry o JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN inquiry r ON r.parent_id = o.id AND r.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN manager rm ON rm.id = r.author_manager_id LEFT JOIN employee re ON re.id = rm.employee_id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.customer_id = #{customerId} AND o.parent_id IS NULL AND o.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer_name, o.title, o.content, o.status, o.created_at, r.content AS reply_content, re.name AS reply_author_name, r.created_at AS replied_at FROM inquiry o JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN inquiry r ON r.parent_id = o.id AND r.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN manager rm ON rm.id = r.author_manager_id LEFT JOIN employee re ON re.id = rm.employee_id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.parent_id IS NULL AND o.is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT status FROM inquiry WHERE id = #{id} AND parent_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry (customer_id, title, content) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{title}, #{content})
INSERT INTO inquiry (parent_id, author_manager_id, content) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{authorManagerId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET status = 'ANSWERED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE inquiry SET status = 'PENDING' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ANSWERED'
UPDATE inquiry SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
